:::{#exr-best-step-length}

#### The best step length for eigenvalues 1 and 9

In [gradient descent](optimization.qmd#def-gradient-descent), a fixed [step length](optimization.qmd#def-gradient-descent) that is too short [converges](algebra.qmd#def-convergent-sequence) slowly,
and one that is too long [diverges](algebra.qmd#def-divergent-sequence).
@thm-best-constant-step gives the best one from the [eigenvalues](linear-algebra.qmd#def-eigenvalue) of $\matr{S}$.

Let $\matr{S} = \sbmat{ 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 9 }$.
Using @thm-best-constant-step, find $\steplen^*$.

:::
